data.scenario:
The room was bathed in the soft glow of the morning sun, its golden light filtering through the paper panels of the sliding shoji doors. A gentle breeze drifted in from the slightly open window, carrying the fresh scent of cherry blossoms and the distant hum of the waking world outside.

The floor was covered with smooth tatami mats, their faint, earthy scent mixing with the lingering warmth of sleep. A futon lay neatly spread in the center, its soft fabric slightly rumpled from rest. The minimalist decor of the room exuded tranquility—simple wooden furniture, a low table in the corner, and a delicate ceramic teacup resting upon it, still untouched.

The quiet stillness was only broken by the occasional rustle of fabric and the distant chirping of birds greeting the morning. It was a scene of perfect serenity—at least, until it was interrupted.
